title: Bayesian Solutions for the Factor Zoo: We Just Ran Two Quadrillion Models
why_not_core: Strong contribution but highly specialized Bayesian/SDF exposition and rapid entry into technical detail reduce general transferability.
evaluation_use: Test whether the asset-pricing skill handles high-dimensional method papers without forcing the selected factor-testing scaffold.

title: Long-Run Risk: Is It There?
why_not_core: Extensive test families could teach a robustness laundry list if used as the main anchor.
evaluation_use: Test whether validation is grouped by failure mode rather than by the order of specifications.

title: Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency
why_not_core: Clear modules but too many predictors, mechanisms, and additional-result blocks for a compact general model.
evaluation_use: Test compression and prioritization for a broad emerging-asset paper.

title: Carbon Returns across the Globe
why_not_core: The corrective, debate-facing framing and strong truth-language are useful locally but unsafe to generalize.
evaluation_use: Test whether a replication/correction task preserves evidentiary caution.

title: CRISK: Measuring the climate risk exposure of the financial system
why_not_core: Validation and mechanism architecture is useful, but the local introduction is truncated and the metric is topic-specific.
evaluation_use: Test measurement-paper routing without relying on a clean extracted introduction.

title: Customer data access and fintech entry: Early evidence from open banking
why_not_core: Strong abstract and quantitative combination, but the local source does not support a reliable full-introduction audit.
evaluation_use: Test source-boundary behavior when one section is unavailable or corrupted.

title: Investor demand, firm investment, and capital misallocation
why_not_core: Strong structural introduction, but the abstract extraction is damaged and the teaching function overlaps the selected quantitative model.
evaluation_use: Test a structural capital-markets application on an unseen topic.

title: The reserve supply channel of unconventional monetary policy
why_not_core: The model-to-demand-system-to-counterfactual sequence is sound but overlaps the selected structural intermediation anchors.
evaluation_use: Test whether the skill transfers to monetary-policy plumbing.

title: A Theory of Liquidity Spillover between Bond and CDS Markets
why_not_core: A strong theory structure was reserved to avoid tuning all theory rules to selected exemplars.
evaluation_use: Test primitives-to-predictions transfer on a held-out market-liquidity model.

title: Investor Memory
why_not_core: The multi-experiment mechanism tree is complete but has many headings and could induce over-fragmentation.
evaluation_use: Test whether the causal skill can compress a multi-experiment paper without losing mechanism distinctions.

title: War Discourse and Disaster Premium: 160 Years of Evidence from the Stock Market
why_not_core: Text measurement and robustness are strong, but the war setting and long front/back matter are unusually specialized.
evaluation_use: Test historical-text measurement and scope calibration.

title: Disclosure of Bank-Specific Information and the Stability of Financial Systems
why_not_core: The phrase robust disclosure is a model concept, not a robustness section, making it a useful keyword-screen counterexample.
evaluation_use: Test that routing and section recognition use semantics rather than keyword presence.
